findings.disposition_reason: Bounded visual candidate pass: all five required originals inspected; identity retained, no unequivocal major geometry or framing defect observed. Not final user approval.
geometry_observations: Pale banded chest, flat-topped mountain, green vegetation and seam band, brass fittings and irregular gray feet preserve promotional identity.
Closed/open desktop and mobile objects are fully framed; cavity and walls read coherently.
Open free-edge brass tab is consistent with released lid-side clasp; two rear hinge-position fittings are separate. Dark clearance alone does not prove detachment.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Viewer stone has more regular bands and sharper faceting; promotional sculpture and vegetation have softer shading. This is finish/detail variation, not demonstrated broken geometry.
visual_limitations: Static endpoint images do not verify continuous motion, collision clearance, hinge-axis correctness, topology or hidden attachments. No runtime or Blender inspection performed in this resumed review.
Marketing is a closed-state promotional illustration, not exact model geometry or interior/rear ground truth.

additional_inspection.finding: Crop does not unambiguously resolve background separating either rear hinge metal from lid/body. Precise contacts are small and partly obscured. Neither correct mechanical attachment nor detachment proven.

hardware_assessment.released_front_clasp: Projecting brass strip at upper/free lid edge approximately x600-632,y248-304 in desktop original; distinct from rear hinges. Its disengagement from body-side catch is expected in open pose.
hardware_assessment.rear_hinges: Two fittings at lower lid/rear rim approximately x560-597,y504-529 and x716-747,y475-497. Dark strip exists between lid and body, but attachment interfaces remain unresolved in full image and native crop.
hardware_assessment.runtime_follow_up: Parent to inspect rear/side views and motion or transforms; do not infer a broken rear hinge from the released upper clasp.
